patches.title: Open Surfaces First
patches.principle: Before opening closed containers, check all open surfaces like tables, shelves, and sidetables for the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is missing and open surfaces are visible.

patches.title: Direct Source Retrieval
patches.principle: If you have a strong suspicion where the target object is, go directly to that location instead of exploring elsewhere.
patches.when_to_apply: When prior context or logic indicates a specific location for the target.
